comment: files.c plname_from_file() and get_saved_games(), and restore.c restore_menu() with mixed play modes. A normal-mode Ranger, an explore-mode Valkyrie and a debug-mode Priest (renamed "wizard") each save. The fourth segment's rc names no hero, so wintty.c tty_askname() shows the selectsaved menu: the copyright banner moves into the menu, each entry is the save header's "name-Rol-Rac-Gen-Ali" text, and because some saves are not normal play every entry carries its playmode prefix ('-', 'X', 'D'); "Never mind (quit)" is preselected. Choosing the explore-mode save restores it. Seeds, clocks, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
